name: Yamaha Bolt
engine: 942 cc air-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: Yamaha's small bobber. Simple to service, with two recalls to clear on some years.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2014 Bolts were in recall 13V298 for a wiring harness that can melt, and some 2020-2021 Bolt R-Specs were in recall 21V806 for an engine case that can leak oil onto the rear tire.
A-002.reason: Both can cause a crash. Repairs are free.

recalls.what: Wiring harness may melt and stall the engine.
Engine case may leak oil onto the rear tire. Do not ride until fixed.
